description:
Return a single meta-prompt covering many items in an analysis.

``scope`` selects which slice to aggregate:
  - ``untested`` — all functions with no tests yet
  - ``partial`` — all functions only partially covered
  - ``failing`` — all failing tests
  - ``everything`` — failing tests plus all untested + partial functions
  - ``frontend`` — TypeScript components grouped with the handlers and
    render branches inside them that nothing exercises yet;
    Playwright/React-Testing-Library oriented rather than a flat
    function list

Cache hits return immediately; cache misses enqueue a fresh
generation and poll for up to ``wait_seconds``. On timeout the
caller gets the ``generation_id`` and can call ``wait_for_prompt``
to keep waiting.

For the common 'fix everything wrong on a branch' workflow, prefer
``fix_branch`` — it takes 'owner/repo' directly and saves the
list_repositories → list_analyses chain.
name: get_bulk_prompt
